    seps = pd.read_csv(seps_file, usecols=['ticker', 'date', 'closeadj'])
    seps['date'] = pd.to_datetime(seps['date'])
    seps = seps[seps['ticker'].isin(tickers)]
    seps = seps.pivot(index='date', columns='ticker', values='closeadj')
    return seps

# Load quarterly fundamentals
def load_fundamentals(sf1_file, tickers):
    sf1 = pd.read_csv(sf1_file)
    sf1 = sf1[sf1['dimension'] == 'ARQ']
    sf1['calendardate'] = pd.to_datetime(sf1['calendardate'])
    sf1 = sf1.merge(tickers, left_on='ticker', right_on='ticker', how='inner')
    sf1 = sf1.sort_values(by=['ticker', 'calendardate'])
    sf1['lag_calendardate'] = sf1.groupby('ticker')['calendardate'].shift(1)
    sf1 = sf1[sf1['calendardate'] > sf1['lag_calendardate']]
    sf1 = sf1.drop_duplicates(subset=['ticker', 'calendardate'], keep='last')
    return sf1

# Compute residual returns
def compute_residual_returns(seps, sf1):
    seps_returns = seps.pct_change()
    sf1_returns = sf1['marketcap'].rolling(3).mean().shift(1)
    sf1_returns = sf1_returns.reindex(index=seps.index, method='bfill')
    residual_returns = seps_returns - sf1_returns
    return residual_returns

# Sort stocks into deciles
def sort_stocks(residual_returns):
    residual_returns_rank = residual_returns.rank(pct=True)
    deciles = np.percentile(residual_returns_rank, [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90])
    deciles = pd.Series(deciles, index=residual_returns_rank.columns)
    deciles = deciles.to_frame('decile')
    residual_returns_rank = residual_returns_rank.join(deciles)
    top_decile = residual_returns_rank[residual_returns_rank['decile'] >= 0.9]
    bottom_decile = residual_returns_rank[residual_returns_rank['decile'] < 0.1]
    return top_decile, bottom_decile

# Compute portfolio returns

    top_decile_returns = seps[top_decile.index].pct_change()
    bottom_decile_returns = seps[bottom_decile.index].pct_change()
    portfolio_returns = (top_decile_returns + bottom_decile_returns) / 2

    grossmargin_factor = SHARADAR_SF1[SHARADAR_SF1['dimension']=='ARQ'].groupby('calendardate')['grossmargin'].sum().reindex(sep_wide.index, method='bfill').values
    netmargin_factor = SHARADAR_SF1[SHARADAR_SF1['dimension']=='ARQ'].groupby('calendardate')['netmargin'].sum().reindex(sep_wide.index, method='bfill').values

Then, it computes the abnormal accruals for each company using the Jones (1991) model and ranks them to form deciles. A long-short hedge portfolio is constructed by going long on the decile with the most negative abnormal accruals and short on the decile with the most positive ones.
